agreement_summary: Final precision confirmation preserves the saturated round-1 Jennifer consensus that Diego round 2 accepted exactly: 60 visually supported nodes and 62 final asserted edges. No visually decisive issue was found in the final pass; UPS_BUS_B to INST_RACK_1 remains uncertain and excluded because no clear terminal-dot landing is visible.
notes: Raw schematic was inspected first and treated as authoritative; component overlay/crops were used only as positional aids.
Power feeders are solid, control/interlock connections are dashed, and crossings/proximities without terminal dots are excluded from asserted connectivity.
CHGR-125A is supplied from BUS-480A via the CABLE 1A-480-7/FDR A-DC solid feeder; CHGR-125B is supplied from the BUS-480E1B/480 V ESS B feeder path via CABLE 1B-480-9/FDR B-DC.
UPS-BUS-A visibly feeds PANEL-RPS-A and INST-RACK-1; UPS-BUS-B visibly feeds PANEL-RPS-B only. The possible UPS-BUS-B-to-INST-RACK-1 relation is left uncertain and excluded.
CB-TIE 1AB is represented by terminal edges to each 4.16 kV bus but no direct BUS-1A to BUS-1B edge is asserted because the tie breaker is shown normally open.
Round 2 final confirmation found no visually decisive reason to alter the Jennifer round-1 / Diego round-2 saturated consensus.
UPS_BUS_B--INST_RACK_1 remains uncertain and is not included in the matrix because the B-side line crossing/nearby routing lacks a clear terminal-dot landing on INST-RACK-1.
